scripts.dev:api: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @blog/contracts build && pnpm --filter @blog/api dev
scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @blog/contracts build && pnpm --filter @blog/api build && pnpm --filter @blog/admin build && pnpm --filter @blog/web build
scripts.build:api: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @blog/contracts build && pnpm --filter @blog/api build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @blog/contracts build && pnpm --filter @blog/admin typecheck && pnpm --filter @blog/api typecheck
scripts.db:psql: docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/docker-compose.yml exec postgres psql -U blog -d blog
